8393013

Hi all,

  please review this small refactoring to more logically group the card set groups in the system according to their use:

* young_gen_card_set_group() moves to G1CollectionSet: G1CollectionSet represents the regions/card set group that are going to be evacuated in the next gc, so move young gen group and selected groups together

* collection set candidates (single G1CollectionSetCandidates instance) moves to G1CollectedHeap: collection set candidates are card set groups/candidates that are evacuated longer term beyond the next gc

This is somewhat in preparation for JDK-8391900, which adds another one of these groups to manage card set groups for humongous objects, but is still quite independent.

Testing: gha

Thanks,
  Thomas
